dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: The house is huge and there's a lot of room.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: There are lots of new things here. It'll take a loooong time to run from one end of the road to the other.

choices.text: Sounds like you're having a fun time.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #If {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight has time, Klee will play with you!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Catching lizards, chasing frogs, drawing, making crafts, hide-and-seek... There are so many fun things to do!

choices.text: You haven't been up to mischief, have you?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Master Jean told Klee many times that Klee can't destroy {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight's house.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So I didn't bring any of my treasures.
